what: 840 GB of a 1,337 GB home was in names no collector lists: coord/ (578 GB of lane worktrees and scratch homes), runner-blaze/ (70 GB, a nested home), v2.store-format-3.backup-20261111 (208 GB, v2 renamed aside by hand after the daemon refused a format-3 store), and the directories of the daemon before v2. The report said 'nothing of blaze's that was collected holds the rest' and named none of them.
cost: a full disk; the report gave nobody a name to act on
cause: a scan that lists three names (build, std, trash) and an account that counts only what it lists
whys: the scan lists only build/, std/ and .blaze-trash
nothing registers what may be under a home
agents and old daemons wrote there freely, and a refused store was renamed aside instead of removed
there was no guard that a home holds only registered names, and no lifetime for anything outside the three
class: bytes with no owner (unregistered writes under a managed root)
prevention: roots::ROOTS registry, the home's pass counting every entry, holders named in the report, roots_fs::unregistered as the guard (crates/blaze-gc/src/roots.rs, roots_fs.rs)
workaround: the owner moves coord/ and runner-blaze/ out and removes the backup
fix: written in int-1112; the daemon does not run the pass yet
